text:
```yaml
name: Auto-approve Copilot workflows
on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/auto-approve-copilot-workflows.yml'
jobs:
  auto-approve:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Auto approve Copilot PRs
        uses: hmarr/auto-approve-action@v4
        if: github.actor == 'github-copilot' || github.actor == 'dependabot[bot]'
        with:
          github-token: "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}"
```
